method: Read EC3 primary table captions/rows and printed footers, checked relevant overlays/errata, then followed event dispatch into current public consumers and inspected assertion bodies. No tests executed in this shard.
scope: Selected additional-action trigger cells in Tables 199–200, emphasizing form and document lifecycle routes that had not been independently cell-indexed in the prior viewer-preferences pass. Table 198 is read only as context for the already recorded B22 ordering finding; Table 197 is not recertified.

source_locations.checked: The introductory text is p.522/507. Table 197 note and page-event order are at p.523/508. The terminal mouse constraints and field-event notes continue at p.525/510.

All rows E/X/D/U/Fo/Bl/PO/PC/PV/PI and Note 1 were read. The table says U is subordinate to /A, Fo/Bl apply only to widgets, PO follows catalog OpenAction and page O, PC precedes page C, and annotation flags do not govern PV/PI (clause Note 1 on p.522).

source_locations.source: Tables 198 and 199 — page and form-field additional-actions dictionaries
source_locations.checked: Tables 198 and 199 share this page. Table 199 caption and all rows were reviewed for this shard; Table 198 was read only to anchor the B22 context. Table 198 O follows catalog OpenAction and C precedes any other page opening; Table 199 lists K/F/V/C and states CO determines calculation order.
WC/WS/DS/WP rows and the continuation DP row were read. WC/WS/WP are before operations; DS/DP are after save/print. There is no automatic catalog DocOpen row.

features.title: Entries in a form field’s additional-actions dictionary

cells_reviewed.source_requirement: Optional ECMAScript action when a user modifies a character in a text field/combo box or the selection in a scrollable list box; it may validate/reject/modify added text.
cells_reviewed.consumer: pdf-model view field edit/commit paths raise Field(Keystroke) when character input is supplied; the viewer editing path reaches these methods.
cells_reviewed.assertion: crates/pdf-script/tests/hook.rs::a_supplied_runner_is_handed_the_keystroke_and_the_format checks typed values, distinct K calls and rejection; viewer-core/tests/script_levels.rs exercises a public viewer entering text and observing the calculated result.

cells_reviewed.source_requirement: Optional ECMAScript action before a field is formatted for display; the action may modify the value before formatting.
cells_reviewed.consumer: pdf-model appearance/value formatting passes Field(Format) through the supplied runner and uses the returned displayed text.
cells_reviewed.assertion: pdf-script/tests/hook.rs::a_supplied_runner_is_handed_the_keystroke_and_the_format asserts displayed '<12>' and exact event sequence; public rendering/query consumers are exercised by field-format tests. This does not certify every host typing/caret path.

cells_reviewed.source_requirement: Optional ECMAScript action when a field value changes; may validate a new value.
cells_reviewed.consumer: ViewState::commit_field and caller commit flows dispatch validate; script result affects commit policy per the adopted RFC/owner semantics.
cells_reviewed.assertion: crates/pdf-script/tests/hook.rs engine module includes commit/validate controls; viewer-core/tests/field_commit.rs covers user-entered values, calculated totals, and observable commit outcomes. The ISO row alone does not prescribe the application’s precise commit/veto semantics.

cells_reviewed.source_requirement: Optional ECMAScript action to recalculate this field when another field changes; document recalculation order is the AcroForm CO entry.
cells_reviewed.consumer: ViewState::commit_field walks the configured CO sequence and hands field calculations to the runner.
cells_reviewed.assertion: viewer-core/tests/script_levels.rs::at_run_the_total_is_computed_by_the_script and pdf-script/tests/hook.rs engine tests assert a literal total after entering field values; field_commit.rs checks a visible/public field result. This supports a bounded calculation route, not all possible CO graphs.

features.effective_errata: EC3 #618 adds Table 199 as a target of Table 226 /AA; it is a cross-reference correction, not a changed trigger condition. Current errata_interactive_batch_current and the form-field AA inheritance review distinguish this from B62 (ancestor AA inheritance).

features.title: Entries in the document catalog’s additional-actions dictionary

cells_reviewed.source_requirement: Optional ECMAScript action before document close.
cells_reviewed.consumer: Viewer::Close and window-close orchestration call run_document_scripts(WillClose) before discarding the document.
cells_reviewed.assertion: viewer-core/tests/document_trigger_timing_audit.rs::catalog_document_triggers_bracket_public_viewer_operations observes a WC report before Event::Closed; pdf-script/tests/document_events.rs checks site identity and rc handling.

cells_reviewed.consumer: viewer-core editing save path invokes WillSave before ViewState::save.
cells_reviewed.assertion: The public timing test verifies WS edit is serialized and DS edit is live-only by reopening saved bytes; engine integration in pdf-script/tests/document_events.rs exercises a real script write.

cells_reviewed.source_requirement: Optional ECMAScript action after a document has been saved.
cells_reviewed.consumer: The public save path dispatches DidSave only when the write returns Ok; the refused/held save route is separately exercised.
cells_reviewed.assertion: document_trigger_timing_audit.rs distinguishes WS and DS output values; document_trigger_timing_residual_audit.rs checks DS is absent on a refused/held save and present iff an actual write occurs, while XFA cleanup remains separate.

cells_reviewed.consumer: Printing::Start runs WillPrint only when the print job passes the reader’s restriction policy; the script edits form state before print rendering.
cells_reviewed.assertion: document_trigger_timing_audit.rs proves the edit reaches actual print-page ink and checks no trigger on Finish without a job; residual timing test checks denied/held print policy paths.

cells_reviewed.consumer: Printing::Finish on an active job dispatches DidPrint after print intent ends.
cells_reviewed.assertion: The public timing test sees the post-DP field value after Finish and verifies a second Finish does not dispatch again; residual test separates active and refused printing.

features.semantic_boundary: The table says when a present action shall be performed; the no-veto/rc=false policy and runner availability are documented owner choices in ADR 1614/Script policy, not additional ISO text. EC3 Table 200 has five lifecycle moments, no catalog DocOpen key. Save/print refusal gates are host policy and are tested separately from table timing.

selected_decisions.review: Reaffirm the call points narrowly: public save/close/print operations deliver the five distinct events; saved output, report order, print pixels, and no-op/denied cases are asserted. Treat false rc as owner policy rather than reading a veto into ISO's timing rows.
Reaffirm distinction: Table 200 DS fires only after an actual save; XFA cleanup postSave may fire after a canceled/held save. The current residual test checks this difference.

Reaffirm actual bounded K/F/commit/C pathways. Additional actions are ECMAScript; fine-grained commit semantics and property write policy derive from adopted owner/RFC decisions and are not represented as ISO-only obligations.

Do not duplicate or broaden B22: Tables 197/198 prescribe catalog action before O before PO; the current public test directly records the opposite ordering. It remains a separate existing finding, outside the Table 199–200 cell conclusions here.

remaining: No dedicated assertion was identified in this shard for every possible form control family or every re-entrant calculation order; assigned form/button and action/script shards cover those boundaries.
No whole-table certification of annotation trigger conditions, visibility layouts, engine compatibility, native host event delivery, or all save/print host pathways.
Table 197 pointer/focus and page visibility event semantics were read only enough to distinguish this pass from prior work; no fresh cell review or execution claim is made.
